name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into the world of motorsport marketing was somewhat unconventional. Starting as a freelance graphic designer after completing his degree at the University of Montreal, he initially focused on local advertising campaigns. A chance encounter with a racing team owner at a charity event led to his first motorsport-related project: designing the team's livery. From there, Jean-Pierre's passion for racing ignited, and he quickly transitioned to a full-time marketing role within the team, honing his skills in sponsorship acquisition, brand management, and fan engagement.

At Scuderia Ferrari, Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous approach to campaign planning and his relentless pursuit of measurable results. He believes that effective marketing isn't just about creating flashy visuals; it's about telling a compelling story that resonates with fans and partners alike. His ability to blend data-driven insights with creative storytelling has consistently delivered impressive ROI for the team's marketing initiatives. His perfectionism, while sometimes frustrating to his colleagues, ultimately ensures that every marketing campaign is executed flawlessly.

What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his unwavering belief in the power of authentic storytelling. In a world of manufactured hype, he strives to create genuine connections between the team, its drivers, and its global fanbase. He's constantly exploring new ways to leverage digital platforms and emerging technologies to enhance the fan experience and drive engagement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Has a quirky habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even if it means staying late.
